summary: Keek was a Nomai from the Vessel who went missing after the crash on Dark Bramble. Keek's partner Plume escaped to Brittle Hollow on Escape Pod 1 and never learned what happened to Keek.

location: Keek was last on the Vessel before it crashed on Dark Bramble.
Keek's fate after the Vessel crash is unknown and Keek was never found.
lore: Keek was a Nomai from Escall's Vessel.
Keek was the partner of Plume.
Plume wrote of Keek: 'The pain of your absence is sharp and haunting, and I would give anything not to know it; anything but never knowing you at all.'
Plume could only hope Keek was safe somewhere, after escaping to Brittle Hollow on Escape Pod 1.
